build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template with a ball, horizontal bar with hole, and jar using creator_lib
create_dynamic_ball: create a dynamic ball object in the PHYRE scene with configurable size and position
add_static_bar: add a static bar object to the PHYRE scene with configurable scale and height
update_task_relationships: update the PHYRE task to define a TOUCHING relationship between a ball and jar
set_solution_tier: set the PHYRE task metadata to SolutionTier.TWO_BALLS difficulty level
